mostWorthwhile.text: Making the mosaic was satisfying: the glass pieces became a finished picture when set in clay.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making the arcade felt less conclusive than expected, and the subsequent paint-making path was initially unclear.

continue.text: I would be mildly interested in another chapter for its material-to-object progressions, though the final sequence was fairly predictable.
